items.title: Restore Jury System In Malaysia For Capital Offences
items.summary: The High Court made a mistake by acquitting the killer in the BU school stabbing of murder. The psychiatric evidence, as detailed in the written judgement, is questionable. Malaysia should restore juries, requiring unanimous verdicts for capital offences. The post Restore Jury System In Malaysia For Capital Offences appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Taiping Hospital Medical Officers Still Awaiting Promotions Due Last Year
items.summary: Some 40 to 50 Taiping Hospital MOs due for promotion to UD48/UD12 in October 2025 have yet to be promoted, with their applications only submitted to JPA last July. Promotions are now expected only around June/July 2027, about two years after they were due. The post Taiping Hospital Medical Officers Still Awaiting Promotions Due Last Year appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: National Health Insurance Is Ideal, But Are We Ready To Pay For It? — David Lim
items.summary: We want better health care. But we also very clearly want to keep paying less for fuel and less in taxes. We can't consistently have both. National health insurance (NHI) might still be the right destination, but the clear path forward right now isn't NHI. The post National Health Insurance Is Ideal, But Are We Ready To Pay For It? — David Lim appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: Different Paths To Universal Coverage: Exploring Health Financing Models
items.summary: A hybrid model should raise public health expenditure to 5% of GDP and introduce a publicly administered health insurance option with community-rated premiums, guaranteed coverage for pre-existing conditions, and genuine competition with private insurers. The post Different Paths To Universal Coverage: Exploring Health Financing Models appeared first on CodeBlue .
